desc:
Pilot a giant mech titan and hold the wall against an endless zombie horde!

DEPLOY from the hangar roof and drop straight into the fight.
HOLD THE WALL with your squad through every siege cycle: the march, the surge and the Behemoth.
TAKE DOWN THE BEHEMOTH before it smashes the gate.
SHOOT DOWN flying Screechers, Gasbags and Carriers.

4 TITANS, 4 WAYS TO FIGHT
- Bulldog: twin gatlings, rocket pods, swarm missiles, ground slam
- Volt: chain-lightning arc gun, lightning strikes, Tesla field, EMP pulse
- Mammoth: siege cannon, mortar barrages, carpet bombs, siege ram
- Mantis: twin scythes, blade dashes, leap strikes, berserk

Earn scrap from every kill and victory, unlock and upgrade titans in the hangar, claim your daily supply drop and climb the Hall of Fame.
Switch to the cockpit view any time you pilot.
Join the group for a one-time 1,000 scrap bonus.

Plays on PC, mobile, tablet and console.
